sections.content: You know *creo que* from B1 Unit 13, *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27, *aunque* from A2 Unit 28 and *porque* and *por eso* from A2 Unit 5. This lesson combines them to defend a position about a difficult rule: state your claim (*creo que…*), give a reason (*porque…*), accept the other side (*aunque…*) and say what should happen (*es importante que…*).

items.spanish: Creo que esta regla es necesaria porque protege a todos.
items.english: I think this rule is necessary because it protects everyone.

items.spanish: Aunque la regla sea incómoda, debemos respetarla.
items.english: Although the rule may be inconvenient, we must respect it.

items.spanish: Es importante que las normas sean justas.
items.english: It is important that rules are fair.

sections.content: With *aunque* + subjunctive you accept a point without saying that it is a fact: *Aunque la regla sea incómoda, debemos respetarla.*
